cells.comment: Capture an image and display it
cells.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
img = cam.capture()
plt.imshow(img, cmap='gray')
plt.axis('off')
plt.show()

cells.comment: Save a capture to a file (PNG or TIFF)
Capture only the green channel (useful for fluorescence)
cells.code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
img_green = cam.capture(green=True)
plt.imshow(img_green, cmap='gray')
plt.title('Green channel')
plt.show()
